art_direction: 比克披白色斗篷在莲池石阶上安静坐着，绿色皮肤与淡紫水光相映。
composition_variation: Create a serene ink-and-gouache anime portrait of Piccolo sitting peacefully beside a lotus pond. Preserve his recognizable green skin, pointed ears, short antennae, serious face, white turban, and flowing white cape over fully covering purple clothing. He sits upright on a broad smooth stone with both hands resting openly on his knees. Place a few pale lotus blossoms near the bottom and subtle water reflections behind him. Use sage, lavender, warm white, muted gold, and a quiet misty upper background. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
